info.name: Event Ledger
info.description: End-to-end checks for the Event Gateway (:8081) and Account Service (:8082). See README section 4.

item.name: B - Core flow (via Gateway)
item.description: Run in order on a fresh start.

request.description: New event: 201, status APPLIED, Location and X-Trace-Id headers.
Idempotent replay: 200 and the original event; balance unchanged.

item.name: B4 Create evt-003 (latest event arrives first)

request.description: Ordered by eventTimestamp: evt-001, evt-002, evt-003.

item.name: C - Account Service directly
item.description: Shows the second service on its own. Needs localhost:8082 reachable: with docker compose it is internal and not published (see the README section Testing the Account Service under Docker), or run it locally with mvn spring-boot:run.

item.name: C4 Currency mismatch (EUR on USD account)
D - Validation (Gateway)
item.description: All return 400 with a clear message.

item.name: E - Tracing
item.description: Copy X-Trace-Id from the response and search both service logs for it.

request.description: Response X-Trace-Id must equal 4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736 and appear in both logs.

item.name: F - Outage (STOP the Account Service first)
item.description: Expectations below hold only while the Account Service is stopped. After restarting it (wait 15 s for the circuit breaker), re-send F1-F3: each returns 200 APPLIED.

request.description: The circuit breaker opens; these fail fast.
